intro.text: Welcome to the guided tour of the Content History feature!

steps.text: **Content History** is accessible via this button, which lists several options for the entry.
This is the Content History interface! It shows the state of your content type at a chosen time.

This is where you can see current and past versions of your content type. For each version, you can see:
• the date and time,
• the name of the user who edited the version,
• and the status (if **Draft & Publish** is enabled).
Let's click on a previous version!
In this previous version, the category was "news" but it was later changed to "nature".
If we want the content type to go back to that previous version, we can click on the **Restore** button.

Restoring a previous version of the content type means overriding the "current" one, but as a draft that can be later published.

Let's confirm by clicking on **Restore** again!
And that's it! We've used Content History to restore a previous version ✨

outro.text: Thank you for following this guided tour!
